questions.prompt: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 생략할 수 있는 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: If [[you are]] hungry, you eat something now.

I ordered soup, and [[Marie ordered]] salad.
We went by bike when [[others went]] on foot.
My brother is good at science but [[I’m good]] at art.

choices.text: Cindy [[does enjoy]] baking bread at home.
